summary: Iteration 4 regression + HMAC signed-URL flow: 16/16 backend pytest tests PASS. Router split is transparent — auth/login, /auth/me, /dashboard/stats, /assets, /audit/cycles (create+close idempotent shape), /departments (admin), role gating (403 for employee on admin-only), brute-force lockout (429 after 5 fails) all still work. NEW signed-URL flow verified: POST /api/uploads returns {file_id,url}; POST /api/uploads/{fid}/sign returns {url:'/api/uploads/{fid}?token=...', expires_at, ttl_seconds:300}; GET signed URL without cookies -> 200 with exact bytes; GET without cookies+token -> 401; GET with garbage token -> 401; GET with tampered token -> 401. The old ?auth=<jwt> query param no longer authenticates (401), on both /auth/me and /uploads/{fid}. Frontend UI smoke: login -> dashboard OK; sidebar nav (assets, allocation, booking, maintenance, audit, reports, notifications) all reachable; Assets RegisterDialog shows both assets-photo-uploader and assets-doc-uploader.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/uploads.py get_current_user is called with the raw Request inside download_file's try/except — works fine because it's the exact signature, but wrapping with Depends elsewhere is cleaner. Not a bug.
scheduler.py `_notified_today` still in-memory (per-pod) — flagged in iteration 3, still open. Move to Mongo TTL for multi-replica correctness.
server.py is now a thin ~78-line bootstrap — split completed cleanly, all 9 routers mounted under /api. Good.
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_dept_*, 1 TEST_it4_* audit cycle (created+closed), a handful of PNG uploads under /api/uploads.
